column3: With respect to the Terra Apartments Mortgage Loan (2.7%), in connection with a 35 year 421-a tax exemption that was applied for with respect to the related Mortgaged Property, the borrower has designated 37 units (30.3% of total units) at the Mortgaged Property as affordable housing units reserved for tenants earning up to 130% of AMI. In addition, all of the affordable units at the Terra Apartments Mortgaged Property are required to be rent stabilized for the duration of the 421-a tax exemption. In addition, the affordable units are subject to limitations on rent, generally equal to 30% of the applicable level of AMI (i.e., 30% of 130% of AMI) less a utility allowance. Furthermore, as of the origination date, 12 units are leased to tenants with CityFHEPS vouchers.
